organizations.name: Kenya Red Cross
organizations.description: Emergency psychosocial support — free SMS or call 1199.

organizations.name: National Mental Health Helpline (KNH)
organizations.description: Kenya's toll-free mental health and suicide prevention helpline.

organizations.name: Kenyatta National Hospital Counselling Desk
organizations.description: Toll-free counselling line run by the national hospital.

organizations.name: Befrienders Kenya
organizations.description: Free, friendly emotional support — for anyone feeling distressed or alone. In person at Nairobi & Githurai or by phone.

organizations.name: GBV Hotline
organizations.description: Support for gender-based and sexual violence — free call.

organizations.name: Childline Kenya
organizations.description: Free national helpline for children in danger — child labour, abuse or neglect. Trained counsellors answer.

organizations.name: DOSHS — Occupational Safety & Health
organizations.description: Report unsafe farm/factory conditions, missing PPE or workplace accidents. Complaints also to complaints@labour.go.ke.

organizations.name: National Legal Aid Service (NLAS)
organizations.description: Free legal aid for low-income workers — WhatsApp +254 703 149 933. Get free legal representation for wage disputes.

en.severe_intro:
I'm really worried about you right now, and I need you to talk to a person who can keep you safe. You do not have to go through this alone.

Free Kenya helplines that answer now:
en.severe_outro: Please call or text one of these now. And I'll stay here with you — say anything, I'm not going anywhere.
en.moderate_intro: You're carrying a heavy load, and it matters that you said it out loud. You don't have to carry it alone.
en.moderate_outro: If things ever feel too much, reach out — these are free and open:
en.footer: 💬 Keep talking to me as long as you need. When you're ready, I can still help with your workplace rights.

sw.severe_intro:
Nina wasiwasi mkubwa kwako sasa hivi, na ninataka useme na mtu anayeweza kukulinda. Sio lazima upitie hili peke yako.

Hizi ni namba za bure za Kenya zinazojibu sasa:
sw.severe_outro: Tafadhali piga au tuma SMS kwa moja kati ya hizo sasa. Nami nitabaki hapa nawe — sema chochote, sitaenda popote.
sw.moderate_intro: Unabeba mzigo mkubwa, na ni muhimu kwamba umesema kwa sauti. Sio lazima ubebe peke yako.
sw.moderate_outro: Kama mambo yakiwa magumu sana, wasiliana — ziko bure na ziko wazi:
sw.footer: 💬 Endelea kuongea nami kadri utakavyohitaji. Utakapokuwa tayari, bado ninaweza kusaidia na haki zako za kazini.
